answer: Count the paid-for signatures, not the accounts. Each new account needs 2 co-signs from accounts older than 20 epochs; each co-sign locks a crystal stake of 6 POA for 30 epochs. N=1 costs 12 POA; N=250 costs 250*2*6=3,000 POA, and stakes cannot be shared. A haven board of 4 reviewers samples 1 in 6 new accounts per epoch and files results in the river record; a confirmed fake burns both stakes. An honest user locks 12 POA once and gets it back. A wrongly flagged user appeals within 6 epochs for a refund. It fails if aged accounts are cheap to rent.
